metadata.modeling_rule: Family relationships are factual person-to-person links. They are never evidence that one spouse shares the other's theology, politics, institutional memberships, actions, or score-bearing network participation.
metadata.app_projection_rule: Project a reciprocal family edge only when both people are canonical research subjects and a reliable source establishes the relationship. Family edges must use weight 0 and score_included false.

source.title: On Marriage by Tim Keller
source.evidence_summary: The PCA Bookstore identifies Timothy and Kathy Keller as co-authors, describes their decades of personal marriage experience, and identifies Kathy as Tim's wife.

relationships.important_boundary: This marriage link supplies family/identity context only. It must not transfer Kathy Keller's positions or committee service to Tim Keller, or Tim Keller's positions, networks, or actions to Kathy Keller.
